extraction.edges: 3x3 Sobel, unsigned angle [0,pi), 8 magnitude-normalized bins; magnitude <=1e-12 ignored
extraction.encoder: Hand-defined inspectable features; not a learned image encoder
extraction.luma: Rec.709-weighted sRGB brightness proxy; no linear-light transform
extraction.resize: Pillow BOX after EXIF transpose and RGB conversion
extraction.semantic_features: Sorted unique traits and motifs; binary, never centered

projection.component_sign: Largest absolute feature loading positive; index tie-break
projection.initialization: Largest residual-variance feature axis; deterministic index tie-break
projection.purpose: Display-only descriptor similarity. Not preference scores, personality axes, or a learned image encoder.
